title: BAS Technician

reviews.manager_strengths: Learning the mechanical side of the BAS world well. Key player in BAS efforts to assist bringing Gainesville online. Willingness to learn will be key in developing into a well rounded BAS Tech.
reviews.manager_opportunities: 2025: scheduled for cross-trade rotations (electricians, mechanics, boiler house, FLS). Small projects to manage. Prep for on-call rotation.

goals.name: 2025 Annual Calibrations
goals.employee_comment: Finished full temp/RH/ΔP calibrations for B1, 12, 26, 29, 30, 31, 32, 50, 55, 56, 64, 74 by 06-30 (~6 weeks ahead of 2024 pace). B19 & B20 60% complete, on-track for 08-31. All calibration sheets uploaded to M-Drive <24h after completion. Need dedicated confined-space attendant (James) for Q3.
goals.manager_comment: Appreciates work on calibrations. Will rely on Zaal for proper calibration methods and professional documentation.

goals.name: 2025 Training & Development
goals.employee_comment: Cross-trade shadowing 100% complete (Electricians, Mechanics, Boiler, FLS, HVAC).
goals.manager_comment: Completed cross-training with all trades and two-week night shift in boiler house. Working on making Zaal the point person for hot and cold calls.

goals.name: AHU Documentation Refresh
goals.employee_comment: 10 buildings' AHUs complete; new template cuts future write-time by ~50%.
goals.manager_comment: Important project — updated information will help new technicians and on-call folks determine how systems are designed at a glance.

goals.name: Energy Savings 2025
goals.employee_comment: Implemented night-setback on 38 AHUs → ~$25k/yr (~140 MWh) savings; statics verified on all supply/exhaust dampers.
goals.manager_comment: Did a great job with the night setback audit.

goals.name: Maintenance Capital Projects 2025
goals.manager_comment: Worked well with Gainesville on PIV communications. Appreciates the drive to learn and ability to teach.
